label: D1 fixation step in the first ~40 trials of an episode while the policy moderately favors a2
explanation: Fires only at D1, never at GO or D2. Nearly every activation (99.9%) falls where the D1 policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) is in [-4.44,-1.52), which is a moderate a2 preference. Within that it is confined to early episode trials (3-49, peaking at trials 10-19, and never on trials 0-2 or 50+), to value in 7.13-7.73, and mostly (88%) to episodes that started with S2 good, where the agent sits on a stable a2 streak. The upcoming action is a2 in 99.9% of activations. It almost never fires after an a1 choice or before a switch. The magnitude is largest on unrewarded D1s (prev_reward=0 holds 78% of the mass) and decays slowly over runs of rewarded D1s. The recorded predicate (D1 & moderate a2 logit & ep_trial<40) uses only observed or computed quantities and gets recall ~0.99 but precision ~0.23 (dev F1 0.37). Adding start_high==0 and ep_trial 3-29 lifts dev F1 to 0.46, but that uses hidden episode structure. The rest of the selectivity looks like slow, episode-specific hidden-state drift that per-step variables do not capture.
